planner_metadata.image_role: From the image, first identify the schematic as the Harbin–Dalian high-speed railway: the marked line connects 哈尔滨、长春、沈阳、大连, all located in Northeast China, and the drawing shows no extension southward to the Yangtze River Delta.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read the prompt wording that the missing phrase is the economic circle before “与长三角经济圈的直接对话”, and that the context is the significance of the Harbin–Dalian high-speed railway.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the geography bridge that Northeast China and its outward-facing port/transport links are commonly associated with the 东北亚经济圈, while 长三角经济圈 is a separate economic region around the lower Yangtze. Since the incorrect statement says this railway directly links that circle with the Yangtze River Delta, the blank before “与长三角经济圈” should be the Northeast Asia economic circle.
